9.label: 9(a)(i)
9.answer: Natural gas combustion emits carbon dioxide and may leak methane. Geothermal usually has lower emissions but may release underground gases or hot mineral-rich water.
9.explanation: Neither is impact-free; controlled geothermal extraction usually causes less air pollution than burning gas.

9.label: 9(a)(ii)
9.answer: Natural gas is finite. Geothermal can be sustained by managing extraction and reinjecting fluids.
9.explanation: A renewable heat source can be depleted locally if removed faster than it is replenished.

9.label: 9(b)(i)
9.answer: Solar cars reduce direct fossil-fuel consumption.
9.explanation: Their panels can obtain energy from replenished sunlight.

9.label: 9(b)(ii)
9.answer: They avoid exhaust emissions while running on solar electricity.
9.explanation: Their full environmental impact also depends on manufacturing and stored energy sources.

9.label: 9(c)(i)
9.explanation: Generation depends on water flow and reservoir level.

9.label: 9(c)(ii)
9.answer: Dams can flood land and displace communities.
9.explanation: Reservoir construction changes land use over a large area.

9.label: 9(c)(iii)
9.answer: Dams disrupt river habitats and sediment movement.
9.explanation: Fish migration and downstream ecosystems can be affected.
